_source: Captured 2026-11-10 from a Move over the manager websocket (every installed module loaded in a scratch project); modules not installed then, or that did not load (belt, belt-in, branchage, chiptune, chordism, denis, essaim, eucalypso, euclidrum, fork, freak, gesture-test, granny, granular, groovebank, keydetect, krautdrums, magneto, midi-player, mono-voice, mrsample, punchfx, radiogarden, rex, signal, smack, smack-in, streamrtsp, structor, tablor, vocoder, webstream, work, wurl), are kept from the 2026-08-28 capture.

ui_hierarchy._comment: MUST stay in sync with the ui_hierarchy served by get_param() in rrverb10.cpp -- neither one is authoritative everywhere. A chain slot (fx1-4) reads THIS copy first; the Master FX bus and send slots read the PLUGIN. Drift shows a different module on each surface, silently. tests/hierarchy.test.mjs asserts they agree.

params.name: Mode
params._short_comment: The grid draws an enum as a two-line 3-char square; without these, M-Tap 1 and M-Tap 2 render as the same cell.
